findings.title: User-facing error and warning text references M200 changelog
findings.description: AC-01 says the deprecation error from `mp config set keybinds.focus_content ...` should be "a clear deprecation message pointing to the M200 changelog". S3 echoes it. The warning text is user-facing (shown in the terminal). "M200 changelog" is an internal milestone ID. Reword to point to the changelog generically.
findings.resolution: AC-01 and S2 (the deprecation warning step) no longer reference M200. The user-facing text now says 'project CHANGELOG' generically. The internal design-decision rationale that mentioned M198 was already internal-only and required no change.

findings.title: Step S1/S2 do not explicitly enumerate the tests and helpers that reference `Keybinds.focus_content`
findings.description: S1 removes the `focus_content` field from `Keybinds`; S2 removes the dispatch arm. Both steps mention the source change but do not call out the call-sites that will fail to compile after the field is removed. Known call-sites that need updating: (1) `keybind_default_label` in `crates/raul/src/tui/modes/settings.rs` has a `"focus_content" => ...` match arm; (2) any test in `crates/raul/src/tui/keybinds.rs::tests` that constructs a `Keybinds` literal with `focus_content: vec![...]`; (3) any other test or fixture under `crates/raul/tests/` that references the field. Either add the call-sites to S1/S2 or rely on the compiler to surface them at execution time (acceptable, but the AC-06 verification should explicitly run a build to confirm no compile break).
findings.resolution: S1 step action updated to enumerate the test call-sites that need to drop the focus_content field: the keybind_default_label match arm in crates/raul/src/tui/modes/settings.rs and any test in keybinds.rs::tests or crates/raul/tests/ that constructs a Keybinds literal with the field. The compiler will surface every other call-site; AC-06 already requires a clean build.
